meta.role: W3 as shipped: global word documents gated by `lexical.lift` on the matrix the attempt decoded (stem: refuse < 0.2, doubt [0.2, 0.3) = every line low + document medium, replacing the envelope gate wherever the lift measured the text; mix: floor 0.15 beside the envelope gate, doubt < 0.6); the LINE_SYNC rung gated by the text's own blind decode (>= 0.5 of lines within 1 s of the placed claims) + lift >= 0.2, the sheet gate only where the decode cannot be read; pinned candidates sent `textConfidence` high. On top of W1 as shipped; DEFAULT-OFF: `m2-order-clamp`, `m6-mix-spare`, `m6-window-spare`, `l1-mix-kept`, `l1-blind-median`, `h3-mix-lift-alone`
